source_verification.claim: Hypoglycorrhachia with normal blood glucose is the key laboratory finding; SLC2A1/GLUT1 deficiency impairs cerebral glucose delivery and ketogenic therapy provides alternate brain fuel.

second_answer_attack.resolution: The defining SLC2A1 phenotype with normal serum glucose and low CSF glucose localizes the defect to GLUT1-mediated facilitated transport across blood-brain-barrier endothelium. GLUT3 is neuronal and does not explain the characteristic hypoglycorrhachia barrier phenotype.

adversarial_second_pass.note: Transporter localization, CSF/blood pattern, ketogenic-diet clue and distractor mechanisms rechecked from zero.
